lead.headline: US CBDC Ban Signals Shift Toward Private Stablecoin Dominance
lead.tldr: A potential US ban on CBDCs until 2030, coupled with institutional stablecoin adoption, reinforces the thesis that private digital dollar rails will win the liquidity war.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: US nears ban on CBDCs until 2030 as housing bill goes to TrumpThe House passed a housing bill with a central bank digital currency ban until 2030, meaning it now just needs US President Donald Trump’s sign-off.
top_signals.summary: The US House of Representatives has passed a housing bill that includes a ban on the issuance of a central bank digital currency (CBDC) until 2030. The legislation now awaits the signature of President Donald Trump to become law.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A legislative ban on CBDCs removes the primary state-sponsored competitor to private stablecoin issuers, creating a massive moat for compliant private assets.

top_signals.title: Ripple launches RLUSD stablecoin in Japan after regulatory approval
top_signals.summary: Ripple has officially launched its RLUSD stablecoin in Japan following regulatory approval. The asset is available to both retail and institutional users via SBI VC Trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Ripple's entry into the Japanese market demonstrates the growing importance of regional regulatory approvals for global stablecoin scaling.

top_signals.title: Abracadabra takes emergency action as MIM stablecoin depeg worsensThe protocol is raising interest rates across all Cauldrons to encourage debt repayment and reduce supply.
top_signals.summary: Abracadabra Money has implemented emergency measures to address a worsening depeg of its MIM stablecoin. The protocol is increasing interest rates across all Cauldrons to incentivize debt repayment and contract the circulating supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The MIM depeg highlights the persistent fragility of algorithmic or under-collateralized stablecoin models in volatile regimes.

top_signals.title: Kalshi in talks to raise funds at $40 billion valuation: FT
top_signals.summary: Kalshi is reportedly in discussions to raise new funds at a valuation of $40 billion. This represents a massive increase from its reported $5 billion valuation in October of the previous year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Kalshi's astronomical valuation jump reflects the market's current obsession with prediction markets as the primary interface for political and economic hedging.

top_signals.title: Credit unions managing $25B in assets join stablecoin infrastructure program11m
top_signals.summary: A group of credit unions managing $25 billion in assets have joined a stablecoin infrastructure program. This move signals increasing institutional adoption of digital asset rails for traditional financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Credit union adoption proves that stablecoin infrastructure is moving beyond fintech disruptors and into the conservative core of traditional banking.

deals.summary: Kalshi is reportedly in discussions to raise new funds at a valuation of $40 billion. This represents a massive increase from its reported $5 billion valuation in October of the previous year.

Sports betting app Onyx Odds has raised $20 million in a funding round led by Payward, the parent company of Kraken. The platform enters a competitive prediction market landscape alongside established players like Polymarket and Kalshi.

Runlayer has raised $30 million in funding to develop a governance layer for the AI agent workforce. The startup is already seeing adoption from major companies including Instacart and a Fortune 500 bank.

on_the_radar.title: DeFi TVL drops 39% in 2026 amid market downturn and record hack activity14m
on_the_radar.summary: DeFi Total Value Locked (TVL) has experienced a significant 39% decline in 2026. This downturn is attributed to a broader market slump and an unprecedented increase in hacking activity.

on_the_radar.title: South Korea adds token securities to capital market overhaul30m, South Korea adds token securities to capital market overhaulSouth Korea’s Financial Services Commission has placed token securities infrastructure within a wider capital-market modernization plan covering faster settlement, longer trading hours and digital transformation.
on_the_radar.summary: South Korea's Financial Services Commission is integrating token securities infrastructure into a comprehensive capital market modernization plan. The overhaul aims to enhance digital transformation, implement faster settlement processes, and extend trading hours.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin miners face deepening margin squeeze as revenue falls below production costs
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin miners are experiencing a significant margin squeeze as operational revenues drop below the cost of production. This trend threatens the profitability of mining operations and may lead to network hash rate adjustments.

on_the_radar.title: Paradigm Backs Kalshi in Latest Prediction Market Challenge
on_the_radar.summary: Paradigm has filed an amicus brief with the Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals to support Kalshi in its legal challenge against Tennessee. The move aims to combat state-level overreach regarding the operation of prediction markets.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin hits 20-month low as market sentiment sours
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin's price has dropped to a 20-month low, falling below the $60,000 threshold. This decline is attributed to a shift in retail investor sentiment away from digital assets and toward AI-related stocks.

on_the_radar.title: Who gets a direct line to the Fed? Congress weighs risks of Fed 'skinny accounts' for crypto and fintech firms
on_the_radar.summary: U.S. lawmakers are debating the risks and benefits of granting crypto and fintech firms access to 'skinny' accounts at the Federal Reserve. The discussion focuses on the level of access these firms should have and the potential systemic risks involved.

on_the_radar.title: Crypto-Backed Candidates Notch Wins in Three US State Primaries
on_the_radar.summary: Crypto-backed candidates achieved victories in three US state primaries, signaling growing political influence for the industry. The Fairshake PAC played a key role in supporting successful candidates, including Democrat Adrian Boafo in Maryland.

on_the_radar.title: Binance co-CEO remains 'committed' to securing EU license after exchange withdraws Greece bid
on_the_radar.summary: Binance is working to secure a license to operate legally within the European Union despite withdrawing its specific bid in Greece. The exchange faces a tight one-week deadline to finalize its regulatory standing in the region.

linkedin_post:
The US is moving toward a formal ban on CBDCs until 2030. For the venture community, the signal is clear: the future of the digital dollar is private. 

While the state steps back, institutional adoption is accelerating. We are seeing a convergence where credit unions managing billions in assets are integrating stablecoin rails, and players like Ripple are securing critical regulatory wins in Japan. Simultaneously, the 'prediction market' thesis is hitting a fever pitch, with Kalshi reportedly eyeing a $40B valuation. 

We are shifting from a period of theoretical utility to one of hard infrastructure integration. The winners won't just be those with the best tech, but those who can navigate the regulatory vacuum left by the absence of a central bank digital currency.

Will the lack of a US CBDC accelerate the adoption of private stablecoins, or create a regulatory gap that hinders institutional entry?
